name: Shivansh
gpu_used: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (6 GB), shared with another training job during Tasks 2-3 timings

task1.bm25_settings: own sparse BM25 (Lucene idf), k1=0.9, b=0.5, title+abstract, lowercase regex tokens, stopwords=removed, Snowball stemming; grid-searched on val nDCG@10

task2.general_model: BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 (109M, query instruction prefix, max 512 tokens)
task2.scientific_model: ncbi/MedCPT-Query-Encoder + ncbi/MedCPT-Article-Encoder (110M each, PubMed-trained, CLS + inner product)

task3.hybrid_method: weighted reciprocal rank fusion over the full corpus: score = 0.2/(60+rank_BM25) + 0.4/(60+rank_BGE) + 0.4/(60+rank_MedCPT); weights grid-searched on train claims, RRF chosen over z-score / min-max score interpolation on val
task3.reranker_model: ncbi/MedCPT-Cross-Encoder (cross-encoder over claim + title/abstract, max 512 tokens), first stage = hybrid

task4.base_model: BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 fine-tuned with MultipleNegativesRankingLoss (in-batch + 1 explicit negative), lr=1e-05, batch=16, max_len=256, up to 2 epochs, best epoch by val nDCG@10

task5.nli_model: MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli (184M), sentence-level + whole-abstract NLI, aggregated by a 3-way logistic regression trained on train claims
task5.zero_shot_or_finetuned: zero-shot NLI model; decision layer (logistic regression + margin) trained/tuned on the train claims only
